decisions.reason: Fast accumulated-history features give the lowest trajectory-level cross-validation error and address the strong residual autocorrelation; alternating input has the greatest predicted disagreement between plausible models.
decisions.prediction: Under rapid input reversals, the memory_fast model will predict a different trajectory from the delay model, especially shortly after each switch.

decisions.reason: memory_slow has the lowest leave-trajectory-out NMSE (0.00417), substantially improving on memory_fast; PRBS provides varied input reversals to test this history-dependent fit.
decisions.prediction: After input switches, memory_slow will predict persistent, gradual output changes rather than an immediate response.

decisions.reason: saturating_memory has the lowest trajectory-level CV error, but its improvement over memory_slow is modest; ramp_reverse has the greatest predicted disagreement among plausible models and probes nonlinear history effects.
decisions.prediction: At large accumulated responses, saturating_memory will predict a more attenuated trajectory than memory_slow during the ramp reversal.
